name: Project Oyster
public_summary: Project Oyster is a research program evaluating salt tolerance and bioremediation potential in oyster mushrooms. We will publish verified culture records, laboratory measurements and field-trial status as the work progresses.
designation_note: "Pleurotus Diego" is a working strain designation for the project line, not a described species. The cultures are Pleurotus djamor (pink oyster).

name: Project Lion
public_summary: A research program on lion's mane (Hericium erinaceus) cultivation, extraction and protein content. Results will be published here as measurements are recorded.

name: Project Fusarium
public_summary: A program to find, collect and study Fusarium species that affect crops and ecosystems. Field and laboratory records will be published as they are verified.

name: MushroomGO
public_summary: A planned field app for recording fungal observations. It is not released yet.

name: MYCO Scholarships
public_summary: Our long-term goal is to establish a recurring grant program for mycological societies. Annual funding levels and recipients will be announced after budgets and program arrangements are confirmed.

name: LAB-IN-A-BOX
public_summary: A program to equip portable mycology labs. Container, equipment and commissioning milestones will be listed separately as each is completed.
